video_title: Michael Wilbon has CONCERNS over Wembanyama's emotional response after WCF 👀 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the Spurs' unfinished business after Western Conference Finals
quotes.excerpt: The job isn't done at all.
quotes.quote: Coming back down from this is a challenge and it's not done yet. We still need to really come back down to earth and realize that we haven't done the hardest yet. The job isn't done at all. So we still got about, I don't know, what time is it? Like 30 plus hours to re-center.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith argues Spurs' emotional hangover is a bigger concern than rust
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say it's the hangover rather than the rust.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say it's the hangover rather than the rust. I understand that rust is a factor when you don't play, playing four games in 23 days. I get that part. But I'm looking at a stat here over the last 10 years, the team entering the NBA Finals with more rest has won seven championships, including five of the last six and each of the past four. I'm going to pay attention to that.

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilbon
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Wilbon on the psychological challenge of Wembanyama's emotional post-game reaction
quotes.excerpt: It is much harder to get over something that is psychological and emotional than something physical.
quotes.quote: Something that's emotional and psychological, which you saw there, and one of the things we love about Victor Wembanyama is his candor and honesty. He was trying to convince himself of that, and his teammates. He knows who's listening to that ultimately. We have to get over this. It is much harder to get over something that is psychological and emotional than something physical.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst compares Wembanyama's emotional state to young Shaquille O'Neal and LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama reminds me of Shaquille O'Neal when he came into the league and when LeBron came into the league.
quotes.quote: Wembanyama reminds me of Shaquille O'Neal when he came into the league and when LeBron came into the league. 1995, Shaq's third year, they make the finals. They beat Jordan, the last series Jordan ever lost. They go seven games with Indiana in the conference finals. Shaq has later admitted that his mental state went away after that. They go into to play the six-seeded Houston Rockets, never forget, underestimate the heart of a champion, they get blitzed. LeBron, 2007, the emotional overcoming of the Detroit Pistons, LeBron's fourth year, age 22, just like Victor. They go into that series, obviously the Spurs were the better team, they were not emotionally able to compete.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith highlights Greg Popovich's role in the Spurs' mental preparation
quotes.excerpt: Greg Popovich is one of the greatest coaches who have ever coached basketball.
quotes.quote: Greg Popovich is one of the greatest coaches who have ever coached basketball. And it wasn't just about X's and O's. It's the mental that he's a specialist in. I know this because Larry Brown taught me that about him. Larry Brown raved about Greg Popovich and what he brought to the table. This man is in their ear. When Victor Wembanyama got the elbow and he got ejected from the game and we were speculating about him getting suspended, when they got off the plane, who was waiting for him? It was Greg Popovich. What did Wembanyama do the rest of the series? See, these are the kind of things that we got to pay attention to. You see Tim Duncan there and David Robinson is sitting around. They ain't just sitting around watching the game like they ain't got something better to do. They are in these guys' ears. So you got to understand, this is what they bring to the table. That pedigree, the tradition, the history of the San Antonio Spurs, led by its leader Greg Popovich, can have a very profound impact.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith warns that the Spurs' size could overwhelm the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Your youth can end up being utilized against you.
quotes.quote: Your youth can end up being utilized against you. We need to understand that from a physical perspective, they have a 7'5" dude and a bunch of dudes surrounding him who all play defense, who all can guard Jalen Brunson. Think about that. They all can guard Brunson. De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, Stefan Castle, Devin Vassell, they got six or seven bodies to throw at Jalen Brunson.
